notes.title: Oasis Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Zone: Oasis!
[/list]
[h1]Features:[/h1]
[h3]Stats Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Edit your Equipment and Loadouts without having to enter a run.
[/list]
[h3]Codex:[/h3]
[list]
[*] View detailed explanations on how the game calculates various stats.
[/list]
[h3]UI Redesign:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Should be much faster to navigate through.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Agility and Luck should be significantly more useful.
[*] Damage Dealt: 100% Attack -> 100% Attack + 50% Agility
[*] The Gold Multiplier scales much better with Luck.
[*] New Luck based “Clutch Power” mechanic.
[*] When a Character is low HP, they have a higher chance of comboing, critting, or dodging. The amount that this chance increases is now based on Luck.
[*] Achievements are more difficult, but less SP is required to upgrade Augments.
[*] Before, you got more than enough SP without thinking much about it. Now, achievement runs will meaningfully help progression as there isn’t enough SP otherwise.
[*] Swapping Equipment allows for a small bit of movement if the swapping would instantly start an Encounter.
[*] Gives a maximum of 5 Distance.
[*] Many various changes to Equipment and Augments to better suit the new stat system.
[/list]
[h3]Ascended Mode:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extra Stat Points are provided once your Character is above the Story’s Max Level.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Too many to count. If you find something that used to be better or is now not working let me know. 
[/list]
